'''Ocean Stone''' is a [[Minerals#Geode Minerals|mineral]] that can be found in the [[Frozen Geode]] and the [[Omni Geode]].

|like=Wizard

==Bundles==
Ocean Stone is not used in any [[bundles]].

==Recipes==
Ocean Stone is not used in any [[Cooking|recipes]].

==Tailoring==
Ocean Stone is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[Tailoring|Ocean Shirt]].  [[File:Shirt193.png|24px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a green dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Quests==
*One Ocean Stone is requested by [[Midnight Squid]] in a [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quest]] to increase the capacity of the pond from 8 to 10.

==History==
{{History|1.4|Can now be used in [[Tailoring]]. Can be requested in a [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quest]].}}
